termination: first goal arrival or 50 actions in both groups
reward: 1 on goal arrival minus 0.01 per attempted action; collision penalty 0
starts: IID uniform non-goal free cells; paired across all groups/models for each seed
goal: fixed lexicographically maximum free cell, identical for all conditions
evaluation: fresh starts/actions, frozen learned weights; within-episode memory writes allowed only when on; reset all dynamic state each episode
memory_ablation: same trained checkpoint, matched evaluation starts and action uniforms; only memory influence disabled
no_rl: prediction learns; actor weights and actor optimizer frozen; no reward or entropy update; policy temperature fixed
random_walk: uniform over four attempted cardinal actions, including blocked directions; Bellec predictor learns, no actor in either group
mlp: 2-64-64-4 local-DFA policy; independent 6-64-64-24 local-DFA next-input predictor
snn: identical Bellec ALIF/prediction architecture and four direct Motor LIFs for No Astro, AstroRL and Trace; detached RL head
initialization: zero readout weights give uniform initial policy for every model; same SNN initialization within a seed
prediction_probe: 512 forced-random transitions in 128 four-transition contexts; shared inputs, disjoint split; offline diagnostic, no extra training or on-policy evaluation episodes
prediction_targets: single MSE between predicted next 24-channel RSNN input code and actual next input code; identical code is written to memory; no auxiliary targets

tuning.selection: independent per group/model/map; maximize mean objective minus 0.25 between-seed sample SD; final seed results never tune or select checkpoints
tuning.no_rl_objective: .4 coverage AUC padded flat to horizon50 + .2 novelty/action + .4 common-probe balanced prediction accuracy
tuning.rl_objective: .5 minmax reward + .3 optimal/actual steps + .2 common-probe balanced prediction accuracy
tuning.random_objective: no-RL objective in both groups; reward cannot train a random walk

metrics.optimal_over_steps: d_star/T; failures at horizon remain marked as failures/censored
metrics.path_efficiency: success*d_star/T, accompanying raw ratio to expose failure-related optimism
metrics.coverage: visited cells including start / all free cells
metrics.coverage_auc_50: coverage curve extended flat, without invented transitions, from early terminal to step50
metrics.backtracking: immediate reversal / successful moves; per-action alternative retained
metrics.occupancy: source-cell count per actual attempted action; normalize within seed then average seeds; walls masked, shared map-specific color scale
metrics.prediction: pre-update input-code MSE/RMSE; diagnostic cell accuracy from nearest fixed code in evaluator only; move/collision strata and shared-input probe

uncertainty: 95% nonparametric bootstrap over 10 independent seeds; paired bootstrap/sign-flip for paired comparisons; Holm within prespecified metric families
limitations: fixed four maps are training tasks, not unseen-map generalization
early stopping makes realized transition budgets unequal despite equal episode caps; plot both episode and transition axes
independent hyperparameter tuning estimates optimized algorithm performance; between-group/model contrasts do not isolate one mechanism
within-checkpoint memory ablation isolates inference influence, not effects of memory on training history
on-policy prediction error depends on visited states; shared-input probes provide common evaluation
MLP and SNN capacities/learning rules differ; report parameter and optimizer budgets
No Astro and random walk without RL have equal uniform behavior; predictors can differ if independently tuned
data_retention: compact tuning summaries, failures, configs and seeds retained; own tuning raw folders removed after durable commit; final scalar histories, occupancy and checkpoint retained
figures: general publication style at 180 mm; PDF/SVG and 600 dpi PNG; journal-specific requirements pending
memory_input: same continuous fixed projection used by RSNN, before spike generation; 24 channels; no RBF or sparsification
prediction_objective: mean((prediction-next_input)**2), averaged over samples and 24 channels
